name: Bruno Kramm
description:
'''Bruno Gert Kramm''' (13 October 1967 – 25 September 2026) was a German musician known for [[programming (music)|music programming]], playing synthesizers and keyboards, and co-fronting and performing backup vocals for the [[electro-industrial]] duo [[Das Ich]], alongside [[Stefan Ackermann]]. Kramm was a multi-instrumentalist, singer-songwriter, and founder of the German [[goth subculture|goth]] club [[Generation Gothic]]. He was also a record producer for a number of musical projects.

Known for his iconic devil-horn hair, Kramm would sport a dark outfit during Das Ich performances, often being significantly more [[makeup|made-up]] than vocalist Ackermann. His vocals brought a deep and intense feel that contrasted with Ackermann's fast-paced, shrill, and excited voice.

Kramm was an active member of the [[Pirate Party Germany]] and was appointed by its board as federal commissioner on copyright issues. In September 2016, Kramm stepped down as party chairman and rejoined [[Alliance '90/The Greens]].

Kramm died on 25 September 2026, at the age of 58, shortly after performing in [[Granada]], Spain.
